check_box.name: reset_toolbar_settings
check_box.label: Reset toolbars to the skin's preferred layout when changing skins.
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled, this option preserves the skin's designed toolbar button layout and will override your chosen button customisations when you change skins.

check_box.name: FSToolbarsResetOnModeChange
check_box.label: Reset toolbars to the login mode's preferred layout when changing login modes.
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled, this option preserves the login mode's designed toolbar button layout and will override your chosen button customisations when you change login mode.
